item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Few scattered showers possible overnight; dry tomorrow
item.description: Tonight we can expect a weak frontal system to swing through the Bay Area, and it may produce a few light, widely scattered showers, but tomorrow will get off to a dry start.

item.title: 'Abbott Elementary,' 'Only Murders' and Disney series score big with 2026 Actor Awards Nominations
item.description: Disney-owned series, including "Abbott Elementary," "Only Murders in the Building" and "Paradise" earned acting and ensemble nods.

item.title: 93-year-old Fremont man charged with wife's murder; tells police they dealt with health issues
item.description: Richard Hocking, 93, from Fremont, has been charged with murder for shooting and killing his 86-year-old wife, Patty, saying it was "necessary" due to health issues, according to court documents. The couple was married for 60 years.

item.title: Federal prosecutors slam Mangione lawyers' 'meritless' claims about Pam Bondi's lobbying ties
item.description: Attorney General Pam Bondi has no conflict that influenced the decision to seek the death penalty in the federal case against Luigi Mangione, prosecutors said Wednesday in a new court filing.

item.title: Golden Gate Park street officially set to be renamed in honor of 'Claude' the albino alligator
item.description: "Claude" the albino alligator touched the lives of countless children during his time as the unofficial mascot of the California Academy of Sciences. Now he's officially set to be honored with a street in his name within San Francisco's Golden Gate Park.

item.title: Nick Reiner's defense attorney unexpectedly withdraws from double murder case during arraignment
item.description: Nick Reiner's defense attorney, Alan Jackson, withdrew from the case during Wednesday's court appearance.

item.title: 37-year-old-woman killed in ICE-involved Minneapolis shooting identified
item.description: The mayor said the ICE officer who shot and killed a motorist acted recklessly and rejected federal officials claims that the officer acted in self-defense.

item.title: Gov. Newsom to deliver final State of the State address amid $18B budget deficit
item.description: The two-term governor faces a projected $18 billion budget deficit in his final year in office, setting the stage for tough decisions and policy battles.

item.title: 2 dead, 6 wounded after shooting outside LDS church in Salt Lake City, police say
item.description: At least eight people were shot, two fatally, at a Mormon Latter-day Saints church in Salt Lake City, police say.

item.title: Protest held in SF following deadly ICE shooting of 37-year-old-woman in Minneapolis
item.description: The rally started at the ICE San Francisco federal building on Sansome, where speakers with various organizations including Indivisible SF, took turns sharing their message in front of the crowd.
